text: And Moses{H4872} answered{H6030} and said,{H559} But, behold, they will not believe{H539} me, nor hearken{H8085} unto my voice;{H6963} for they will say,{H559} Jehovah{H3068} hath not appeared{H7200} unto thee.

And Moses{H4872} said{H559} unto Jehovah,{H136} Oh,{H994} Lord,{H136} I{H376} am not eloquent,{H1697} neither heretofore,{H8032} nor since{H227} thou hast spoken{H1696} unto thy servant;{H5650} for I am slow{H3515} of speech,{H6310} and of a slow{H3515} tongue.{H3956}

And thou shalt say{H559} unto Pharaoh,{H6547} Thus saith{H559} Jehovah,{H3068} Israel{H3478} is my son,{H1121} my first-born:{H1060}
